item.title: U.S. importers flood trade court with tariff refund claims
item.description: Importers file 2,000 lawsuits at the U.S. Court of International Trade seeking $130B in tariff refunds after the Supreme Court ruled Trump-era duties illegal.

item.title: Iran war poses new risk to U.S. economic resilience
item.description: Trump’s Iran strikes lift oil prices and rattle markets, raising risks to U.S. growth, inflation and Federal Reserve rate plans amid global trade uncertainty.

item.title: Sherburne County considers sales tax to fund jail upgrades
item.description: Sherburne County may propose a 0.25% local sales tax to fund $45M jail renovations, addressing space, HVAC, and safety issues noted in 2024 inspections.

item.title: Milwaukee area eases zoning codes to accommodate ADUs
item.description: Milwaukee-area communities ease ADU zoning to boost affordable housing, while Wisconsin lawmakers weigh a bill to allow backyard homes statewide.

item.title: Price for Coon Rapids apartments is $42.75M
item.description: The 180-unit Lyra at Riverdale Station in Coon Rapids sold for $42.75 million in a mortgage assumption deal with a 2.5% interest rate.

item.title: Target’s new CEO outlines growth plans for 2026
item.description: Target CEO Michael Fiddelke outlines plans to restore sales growth through store expansion, faster delivery and beauty, food gains amid weak discretionary spending.

item.title: Just Sold: Apartment sales pop up across the market
item.description: Two small apartment building sales closed in Stillwater and Brainerd, totaling $8.5M, with strong investor demand and multiple offers.

item.title: U.S. housing supply gap widened further in 2025
item.description: Realtor.com reports the U.S. housing supply gap rose to 4.03M in 2025 as 1.41M new households formed, worsening affordability for first-time buyers.

item.title: Warehouse pitch at ex-Thomson Reuters campus advances
item.description: Ryan Cos. wins planning commission approval for a 377,000-square-foot warehouse at the former Thomson Reuters campus in Eagan.

item.title: Rochester approves $139M CityWalk Apartments
item.description: Rochester EDA approves development agreement for the $139M, 342-unit CityWalk Apartments near Mayo Clinic, the city’s largest multifamily project.
